messages:
Alex Morgan: CI red on feature/logger-splay after rebasing on main -- integration test failing for serialization. looks like a proto change?
Mira Patel: which test? can you paste the failing trace?
Alex Morgan: here's the core of the failure:
```
FAILED tests/logging/test_splay_integration.py::test_emit_shard - TypeError: serialize() got an unexpected keyword argument 'field_ordered'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/workspace/tests/logging/test_splay_integration.py\", line 58, in test_emit_shard
    out = splay.emit(shard)
  File \"/workspace/splay/serialize.py\", line 22, in emit
    return proto.serialize(shard, field_ordered=True)
TypeError: serialize() got an unexpected keyword argument 'field_ordered'
```
Cheng Wu: hmm that signature change came in upstream proto-splay v1.4.0 — main pulled it yesterday. feature branch still expects v1.3.x API.
Sam Rivera: ok makes sense. @Alex quick options: 1) pin dependency to 1.3.x in the branch, 2) update callsites to new signature, or 3) if it's a transient CI issue, rerun to confirm.
Alex Morgan: will rerun job first to rule out flake. CI-Bot can you rerun job 8921?
CI-Bot: Rerun requested for build #8921 by Alex Morgan. Queueing job...
Mira Patel: if rerun still fails we'll need a short bisect to find when main introduced the proto bump. I can help run that if you want.
CI-Bot: Build #8921 finished: FAILURE (same error).
Alex Morgan: rerun failed, confirmed reproducible locally too. I started a quick git bisect between main@refs/heads/main~50 and HEAD but stopped to ask for input.
Cheng Wu: sounds good. For bisect, narrow to commits that touched pyproject.lock / deps. I suspect the bump was in infra/requirements or the workspace lock.
Sam Rivera: assign owner for remediation? @Mira want to pick updating the branch to the new proto API? if you prefer, we can pin in the short term and follow up with API changes.
Mira Patel: I can update the callsites in logging/serialize to use `proto.serialize(shard)` (drop field_ordered) and add compatibility wrapper. I'll open a tiny PR on the branch. ETA ~1.5h.
Alex Morgan: thanks! I'll pin to 1.3.x in the pipeline to stop further CI churn while you work: adding `proto-splay==1.3.*` to the tox env in the branch pipeline.
Cheng Wu: once Mira's PR is up, let's run the full matrix and then remove the pin. Also add a quick unit to cover serialize signature so it fails-fast on future bumps.
Mira Patel: yep adding unit test now. small patch:
```
# tests/unit/test_serialize_compat.py
from splay import serialize
def test_serialize_compat_calls_proto_no_field_ordered():
    # smoke: ensure serialize works with current proto-splay API
    assert callable(serialize)
```
Sam Rivera: ping me on the PR, I'll review quickly. Also Alex, can you add a short note in the branch PR description about the dependency drift so QA isn't surprised?
Alex Morgan: will do.
Mira Patel: opened PR on the feature branch: `feature/logger-splay | compat: adapt to proto-splay v1.4` — link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/feature/logger-splay/pull/37 : added compatibility wrapper + unit.
Alex Morgan: updating pipeline pin now, pushing patch. CI-Bot: please kick the pipeline after PR merge.
CI-Bot: Pipeline queued for commit 7a3f9b2 on feature/logger-splay.
Cheng Wu: nice. follow-up: create a short runbook note under docs/ci about how to handle dependency bumps that affect public serialization APIs. small ops win.
Sam Rivera: agreed. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: will add the runbook item after merge.
Alex Morgan: last_message: thanks team — moving to tracking card infra-463 to follow removal of pin and add test to main.
